rumors.why: State-backed buying would support global risk appetite into the half day; SPY premarket +1.5% fits

rumors.text: India-US trade deal nears completion even as Washington proposes 25% tariffs on India

rumors.why: Bear fade thesis; gap fills are common but not reliable on thin holiday sessions

rumors.why: Unverified level from one poster; would cap upside today

rumors.text: AI debt bubble / AI spending collapse will trigger a correction (carried over, stale)
rumors.why: Credit stress at AI borrowers would pressure chips and the index

readings.whats_new: Market reopens for a half day with SPY gapping +1.5% premarket to ~727 on a global bounce; last hour's unverified futures-up rumor proved right. Stocktwits SPY score jumped 57 to 77 (bullish tags still ~50%). New chatter: China state buying, India-US deal; Brazil ETFs/stocks up 11-13% and VRTX -8.5% with no cause found.
